FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 214
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/26/2024
House Bill 214 as introduced would prohibit the state from levying any additional tax than
would otherwise be levied on transactions made with digital assets. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
